title: Derepeat
text: Reduce sampling rate by averaging consecutive samples, 1 input, 1 output, {Initial condition} sets Initial condition; {Derepeat factor, N}, {Input processing} and {Rate options} sets the block processing rate Allow multirate. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Input processing control Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Block processing rate Allow multirate processing (default) | Enforce single-rate processing
